purpose: Teach: ウインドウ/バッファ/パッド/万能/ニセ/ホームステイ/舞踊/アンサンブル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、お店のウインドウディスプレイ、お好きなのよ
lines.en: You know, Sho — your dad actually has quite an eye for window displays.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle observation like she's sharing something she's noticed and wanted to mention. Unhurried, thoughtful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題にバッファ時間入れたよ
lines.en: Mom, I built in some buffer time for my homework.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward delivery. A small note of pride in the accomplishment — not boastful, just matter-of-fact. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの肩パッドの入ったコート、お洒落よね
lines.en: Your dad's coat with the shoulder pads — it really is stylish, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused observation. The tone of someone noticing something nice and wanting to acknowledge it aloud. Gentle, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、万能じゃないって、お祖父ちゃんに言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me I'm not good at everything.
lines.style: Small, wry acknowledgment. Not complaining — just reporting something he's turning over in his mind. Slight lift at the end, inviting her perspective.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ニセのメッセージに気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful of fake messages, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm direction. The tone of a mother who cares and wants to protect without sounding alarmed. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達のホームステイ先に遊びに行きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go visit my friend's host family.
lines.style: Eager, direct request. A note of anticipation in the voice — he wants something and is asking clearly for it. Not demanding, just honest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが日本舞踊習ってたのよ
lines.en: Your grandmother actually studied Japanese dance for years.
lines.style: Warm reminiscence. The tone of sharing a small piece of family history — something she's proud of and wants him to know. Unhurried, gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、合唱コンクールでアンサンブル歌ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I sang in the ensemble for the choir competition.
lines.style: Genuine quiet satisfaction. No false modesty, no overdoing it — just reporting something he did and feels good about. Direct, calm, grounded.
